Name: Fort Teleman
Notes:
Active border fort with Argonia manned by some legionnaires led by Legate Maderius:

Imperial, M, 50s. Balding, with gray hair, scarred. Legate of Fort Teleman. Maderius is a veteran of County Leyawiin's guerilla campaign during the Great War. His loyalty to the Empire is only surpassed by his loyalty to Countess Caro, having witnessed her take charge of the campaign after her father died. Many believe his cantankerous attitude comes from being banished to a remote and unimportant fort on the fringe of Cyrodiil, but that's simply his normal attitude toward things. He knows the value of Fort Teleman as a fall-back position should Leyawiin fall again in the next war, and wouldn't want to be anywhere else. The fort is surprisingly well-stocked even if it does appear to be undermanned. This might make it a tempting target for ne'er-do-wells seeking to pilfer the Legion's reserves.

Name: Melchior's Manor
Notes:
UC house for the head honcho of the Black Market, as much as there would be a head honcho that is.

For those acquainted with Anvil, they know Melchior as the crime boss who runs the Black Market of Anvil. Commonly described as “unsettling”, Melchior is known for his eerily calm voice that never rises above a whisper. Some might take his placid nature as submissiveness, but such people never last long...none do when they encounter Melchior’s true nature. Interestingly enough, he will never step foot in the Black Market; instead entrusting that to Prisca, who will come to Anvil and give him a report at the end of every week. He lives a rather cushy life.

Melchior owns the general goods central store in Anvil's Bazaar (his “legitimate” occupation) but will leave it, and usually gets one of his employees (a trusting, rather innocent Bosmer named Edhelas) run the shop instead. He should wander around town instead and have conversations with his...associates.

Name: Priory of Morihaus
Notes:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VpxOUAvV0aL7gYn0_1YObCJ2vZaavLfbcmXFr9WF9ww/edit

Located north of Fort Sutch, the Priory of Morihaus has been a resting place for travelers and pilgrims throughout Colovia since it was founded by Titus Mede I, sometime after Mede's capture of the Imperial City. The Priory is unique, in that it serves as both a warrior's lodge as well as a religious site.

‌

While some monks dedicate their duties to maintaining the priory grounds, cooking or cleaning the stables, others don the garb of warriors and mercenaries - patrolling their local area to keep it safe from highwaymen and dangerous critters. Due to its history with the Mede dynasty, most of the Morihati Monks here are Colovian or Cyro-Nord, and between them there is a small level of theological contention regarding the nature of Morihaus.

‌

Name: Gold Coast Fishing Company
Notes:
The Gold Coast Fishing Company is the big bad fishing corporation of Western Cyrodiil. The GCFC has tons of employees, representative of a larger corporation. This building is their corporate headquarters, but their business is done in the Bazaar.

In the Bazaar, they have a large fish and fish-related supplies stand. This stand dwarfs the local stands, like those run by people like Darga Faust. AnvilUC05

Name: Astius Vunon's Shack
Notes:
FIX NORTH MARKER AFTER RO’S EXTERIOR WORK - 04.01.2026

Astius Vunon's Shack - Elderly Imperial resident of the poor quarter. Astius is a retired veteran of the Great War, which left him without his wife or children. He is very bitter about his experience, and sees the Empire as weak. Astius is not welcoming of the refugees, who he thinks are Dominion assets. Would be appropriate to have a suit of Imperial Light Armor and some other old war mementos. Lowerclass 02 Astius Vunon - Retired veteran, lives alone. [Heartlander]

Name: Armelia Fatelia's House
Notes:
Head of EEC operations in Anvil. Very organized and wealthy. She used to date the Dunmer who owns the alchemy shop, Veroth.

Houses: Armelia Fatelia - Head Factor of Anvil's EEC. The house is hers.

Deputy Zaida (joins Armelia in her bed late at night) - EEC CFO K

Isari - Innocent maid from Elsweyr - has a small room here

Name: The Hunting Spot
Notes: The Hunting Spot - store selling mostly hunting supplies, owned by Nelonir, a Bosmer fletcher and hunter. His assistant Velasi Romalen works in the shop on the days Nelonir’s away hunting. Could probably have some hunting trophies on the walls. Middleclass 06 Nelonir — Bosmer fletcher and hunter, runs The Hunting Spot. [Neutral] Ralvas Alar — Veteran of the Great War. Looks after the store as a guard in exchange for a spare room to sleep in. [Neutral]

Name: Gold Coast Mansion
Notes:
Owned by Warden of the GCFC, Francis of Anvil. He lives with his three wives and pet mountain lion named Cougar. There is one master bedroom with one bed that can fit two. There is a second room with three beds. The wives switch off between their bed in this bedroom, and Francis's bed.

Party house. Very playboy mansion-like. Somewhere in his house is an office space where he works. Should have LOTS of fish-related things around. Employees of GCFC come to party on Fredas. Basement could be a game room or love chamber or massive wine cellar - this man is rich. Lots of fish-decorated things.

Francis of Anvil - Male redguard, Warden of GCFC. Simone - Wife #1. Thinks she's queen wife, and passively attempts to protect this. Doesn't get along with her family back home. Loves traveling the world and souvenirs but in a superficial way. Felicia - Wife #2. Southern hospitality. A little ditsy but really loves the simple things in life. Involved in Dibella Misc Quest. Stereotypically hedonistic-like Dibellan Arts. An-Makano - Wife #3. Recently came from Black Marsh. Learning about Dibella from the other wives. Everything she says has an unsettling subtext to it. Gives good massages.

Several texts are written to be placed inside, see folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GHE-rHi8saAV4ythAXUcTrme4M7BQ-Aa AnvilUC03

Name: The Wisp And Veil
Notes: The Wisp and Veil - A magic store owned by Seras Relith. He is a respected Dunmer wizard and scholar who decided to retire from an academic career to sell some of the research he spent much of his life acquiring. He specializes in custom spells and soul gems. Has nice display cases filled with very expensive items, especially magic in nature. Maybe one filled with high-tier soul gems or ayleid stones, another case filled with an enchanted weapon or stave etc. Middleclass 01 [This is where the old Abandoned DB house used to be, if referenced] Seras Relith — Old wizard and retired academic. Owns the Wisp and Veil, also authored several books. [Neutral]

[Ashborn] Llersi Sadus — Daughter of Ilvera and Neran. Very serious and mature, highly ambitious. [Ashborn]

Name: Sarvena's House
Notes: Sarvena’s House - Owned by Sarvena, the proprietor of the Red Bastion Cornerclub. The house itself appears normal, but in the basement there is a trap door leading to a network of caves and tunnels once used for storing and smuggling illicit substances, although it was cleared out and abandoned when Sarvena renounced her life as a smuggler. The player will find Sarvena held hostage in here during the Other Side. Should be cluttered with Dunmeri furniture and clutter. Middleclass 04 Sarvena — Owner of the Red Bastion Cornerclub. Lives here when she isn't working at the cornerclub. [Ashborn]
